title: xEdge Core Configuration
description: Schema for the core section of xedge.yaml (FR-CM-001). Per-driver schemas are loaded and validated independently by the driver framework (FR-DF-004).

schema_version.description: Config schema version, e.g. '0.1'. Used by the migration tool (NFR-M-003).

interval_seconds.description: Must kick at least once per 30s per NFR-R-005; default kicks at 2x that margin.

drivers.description: Driver instances. Each driver's `config` and `tag_groups` are validated against that driver type's own schema (FR-DF-004) — not enumerated here in Sprint 1.

northbound.description: Northbound MQTT + Sparkplug B connector (FR-NB-001..FR-NB-006). Only a single connector is supported in Sprint 3; FR-NB-005 (>=3 simultaneous connectors) is later-sprint scope.

publish_interval_seconds.description: How often the dispatcher drains the ring buffer and publishes an NDATA batch.

opcua_server.description: OPC UA server exposing active tags (FR-UA-001..FR-UA-007). MVP: no security policy beyond None, no user auth — see xedge.northbound.opcua_server module docstring.

store.description: Store-and-forward: RAM ring buffer (hot tier) spilling to SQLite WAL (cold tier) on overflow (FR-SF-001..FR-SF-003, ADR-003).

ram_max_depth.description: FR-SF-001: samples held per stream before spilling to the cold tier.

purge_interval_seconds.description: How often the retention purge sweep runs.

config_management.description: Config hot-reload and version history (FR-CM-002, FR-CM-005, FR-CM-006).

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often xedge.yaml's mtime is checked for changes.

max_versions.description: FR-CM-006: last 10 versions retained by default.

api.description: Read-only REST API v1 (FR-CM-003): status, driver list, running config. No auth in the MVP, so it defaults to loopback-only — see xedge.api.server module docstring before setting `host` to anything broader.

host.description: Loopback-only by default since there's no auth yet. Set to a specific interface address (not 0.0.0.0) if the API needs to be reachable from elsewhere on the OT network.
